breadcrumbs.translated_name: The Chapter on the Root of All Things

full_breadcrumb: Middle Discourses Collection > The First Fifty > The Chapter on the Root of All Things > The Root of All Things

segments.mn1:0.1: আমি এইরূপ শুনিয়াছি। এক সময়ে ভগবান উ Ukkaṭṭhā নগরে সুভগ বনে শালবৃক্ষমূলে বিহার করিতেছিলেন।
segments.mn1:1.2: [Bengali] At one time the Buddha was staying near Ukkaṭṭhā, in the Subhaga Forest at the root of a magnificent sal tree.
segments.mn1:1.3: [Bengali] There the Buddha addressed the mendicants,
segments.mn1:2.1: [Bengali] “Mendicants, I will teach you the explanation of the root of all things.
segments.mn1:2.2: [Bengali] Listen and apply your minds well, I will speak.”
segments.mn1:3.1: [Bengali] “Take an unlearned ordinary person who has not seen the noble ones, and is neither skilled nor trained in the teaching of the noble ones. They’ve not seen true persons, and are neither skilled nor trained in the teaching of the true persons.
segments.mn1:3.3: [Bengali] Having perceived earth as earth, they conceive it to be earth, they conceive it in earth, they conceive it as earth, they conceive that ‘earth is mine’, they approve earth.
segments.mn1:3.5: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:4.2: [Bengali] Having perceived water as water, they conceive it to be water …
segments.mn1:4.4: আমি এইরূপ শুনিয়াছি। এক সময়ে ভগবান উ Ukkaṭṭhā নগরে সুভগ বনে শালবৃক্ষমূলে বিহার করিতেছিলেন।
segments.mn1:5.2: [Bengali] Having perceived fire as fire, they conceive it to be fire …
segments.mn1:5.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:6.2: [Bengali] Having perceived air as air, they conceive it to be air …
segments.mn1:6.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:7.2: [Bengali] Having perceived creatures as creatures, they conceive them to be creatures …
segments.mn1:7.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:8.2: [Bengali] Having perceived gods as gods, they conceive them to be gods …
segments.mn1:8.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:9.1: [Bengali] They perceive the Progenitor as the Progenitor.
segments.mn1:9.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the Progenitor as the Progenitor, they conceive him to be the Progenitor …
segments.mn1:9.4: আমি এইরূপ শুনিয়াছি। এক সময়ে ভগবান উ Ukkaṭṭhā নগরে সুভগ বনে শালবৃক্ষমূলে বিহার করিতেছিলেন।
segments.mn1:10.1: [Bengali] They perceive the Divinity as the Divinity.
segments.mn1:10.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the Divinity as the Divinity, they conceive him to be the Divinity …
segments.mn1:10.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:11.1: [Bengali] They perceive those of streaming radiance as those of streaming radiance.
segments.mn1:11.2: [Bengali] Having perceived those of streaming radiance as those of streaming radiance, they conceive them to be those of streaming radiance …
segments.mn1:11.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:12.1: [Bengali] They perceive those of universal beauty as those of universal beauty.
segments.mn1:12.2: [Bengali] But then they conceive them to be those of universal beauty …
segments.mn1:12.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:13.1: [Bengali] They perceive those of abundant fruit as those of abundant fruit.
segments.mn1:13.2: [Bengali] Having perceived those of abundant fruit as those of abundant fruit, they conceive them to be those of abundant fruit …
segments.mn1:13.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:14.1: [Bengali] They perceive the Vanquisher as the Vanquisher.
segments.mn1:14.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the Vanquisher as the Vanquisher, they conceive him to be the Vanquisher …
segments.mn1:14.4: আমি এইরূপ শুনিয়াছি। এক সময়ে ভগবান উ Ukkaṭṭhā নগরে সুভগ বনে শালবৃক্ষমূলে বিহার করিতেছিলেন।
segments.mn1:15.1: [Bengali] They perceive the dimension of infinite space as the dimension of infinite space.
segments.mn1:15.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the dimension of infinite space as the dimension of infinite space, they conceive it to be the dimension of infinite space …
segments.mn1:15.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:16.1: [Bengali] They perceive the dimension of infinite consciousness as the dimension of infinite consciousness.
segments.mn1:16.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the dimension of infinite consciousness as the dimension of infinite consciousness, they conceive it to be the dimension of infinite consciousness …
segments.mn1:16.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:17.1: [Bengali] They perceive the dimension of nothingness as the dimension of nothingness.
segments.mn1:17.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the dimension of nothingness as the dimension of nothingness, they conceive it to be the dimension of nothingness …
segments.mn1:17.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:18.1: [Bengali] They perceive the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception as the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception.
segments.mn1:18.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception as the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception, they conceive it to be the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception …
segments.mn1:18.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:19.1: [Bengali] They perceive the seen as the seen.
segments.mn1:19.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the seen as the seen, they conceive it to be the seen …
segments.mn1:19.4: আমি এইরূপ শুনিয়াছি। এক সময়ে ভগবান উ Ukkaṭṭhā নগরে সুভগ বনে শালবৃক্ষমূলে বিহার করিতেছিলেন।
segments.mn1:20.1: [Bengali] They perceive the heard as the heard.
segments.mn1:20.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the heard as the heard, they conceive it to be the heard …
segments.mn1:20.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:21.1: [Bengali] They perceive the thought as the thought.
segments.mn1:21.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the thought as the thought, they conceive it to be the thought …
segments.mn1:21.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:22.1: [Bengali] They perceive the known as the known.
segments.mn1:22.2: [Bengali] Having perceived the known as the known, they conceive it to be the known …
segments.mn1:22.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:23.2: [Bengali] Having perceived oneness as oneness, they conceive it to be oneness …
segments.mn1:23.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:24.2: [Bengali] Having perceived diversity as diversity, they conceive it to be diversity …
segments.mn1:24.4: আমি এইরূপ শুনিয়াছি। এক সময়ে ভগবান উ Ukkaṭṭhā নগরে সুভগ বনে শালবৃক্ষমূলে বিহার করিতেছিলেন।
segments.mn1:25.2: [Bengali] Having perceived all as all, they conceive it to be all …
segments.mn1:25.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:26.2: [Bengali] Having perceived extinguishment as extinguishment, they conceive it to be extinguishment, they conceive it in extinguishment, they conceive it as extinguishment, they conceive that ‘extinguishment is mine’, they approve extinguishment.
segments.mn1:26.4: [Bengali] Because they haven’t completely understood it, I say.
segments.mn1:27.1: [Bengali] A mendicant who is a trainee, who hasn’t achieved their heart’s desire, but lives aspiring to the supreme sanctuary from the yoke, directly knows earth as earth.
segments.mn1:27.2: [Bengali] Having directly known earth as earth, let them not conceive it to be earth, let them not conceive it in earth, let them not conceive it as earth, let them not conceive that ‘earth is mine’, let them not approve earth.
segments.mn1:27.4: [Bengali] So that they may completely understand it, I say.

segments.mn1:147.4: [Bengali] Because the Realized One has completely understood it to the end, I say.
